To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The wear resistance of laser clad Stellite 6 can be significantly improved by using a hard martensitic stainless-steel substrate.

the Stellite 5 coating applied on a martensite/bainite stainless steel substrate by laser cladding has a significantly high wear resistance and that the dilution and coating carbon content of the coating are important factors affecting the coating wear resistance.
the Stellite 1.8 coatings on the martensitic stainless steels with lower laser power have less dilution, less cracking, higher hardness and lower wear than those with higher laser power.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a laser cladding process for producing a hard coating on a martensite stainless steel (MSS) substrate.
the laser cladding of Stellite 6 on martensitic stainless steels and the effects of dilution on the coating wear resistance.
laser cladding of Stellite 6 onto a martensitic steel substrate with the aim of producing a coating with high wear resistance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Stellite 6 deposited onto martensitic stainless steels by laser cladding is a viable and cost effective method for improving wear resistance.
the wear resistance of Stellite 6 deposited on martensitic stainless steels can be enhanced by reducing dilution and increasing coating C content.
the Stellite 5 coatings on the low C martensitic/bianitic steel substrates possess significantly high wear resistance and the Stellite 1 coatings possess the lowest wear resistance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the laser power and the laser power density are the two most important factors affecting the dilution, the coating C content and the coating hardness.

the Stellite 5 coating on a martensitically tempered stainless steel substrate is an attractive alternative for wear protection in applications where the substrate is exposed to a combination of abrasive and adhesive wear.
the Stellite 1 coating on the martensitic/baintic steel substrate is the best combination for wear resistance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dilution and coating microstructure have a strong impact on the wear resistance of laser cladded Stellite 6.
the wear resistance of a laser clad coating depends strongly on dilution and C content of the coating.
the wear resistance of a coating is not just a function of the coating composition and structure, but also the substrate structure and the degree of dilution between the coating and the substrate.
